mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(customers.id) FROM crm_activities_cards INNER JOIN users ON users.id = crm_activities_cards.created_by AND users.is_active = 1 INNER JOIN crm_activities_status ON crm_activities_cards.action_status = crm_activities_status.id INNER JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = crm_activities_cards.customer_contact_id AND customer_contacts.is_active IN (1,3) LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = customer_contacts.customer_id AND customers.is_active IN (1,3)
